title: Government Scheme Impersonation
summary: Increase in messages impersonating PM Modi and central government schemes. Messages promise subsidies or pensions in exchange for registration fees.
recommendation: Government schemes never charge processing fees. Verify schemes on official government portals. Report to cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Telegram Investment Group Scams
summary: Fraudsters creating Telegram groups promising high-return stock tips and crypto investments. Victims are gradually defrauded through fake trading platforms.
recommendation: Be cautious of unsolicited investment tips on messaging platforms. Verify SEBI registration of advisors. Do not invest based on Telegram group recommendations.
